dict.string: Each enabled app sees its own stable fake device instead of your real one. The identity stays the same across launches, so apps keep working, but no two apps see the same device.

Gives every enabled app a brand-new device. This is the deliberate version of "appear as a new phone" - pulled when you want it, rather than on every launch, which would log you out constantly and stand out as anomalous.

This defeats ad networks and analytics SDKs. It cannot defeat DeviceCheck or App Attest, which are enforced on Apple's servers and in the Secure Enclave, nor sensor-calibration fingerprinting, nor your IP address.
Do not enable it for banking, payment or authenticator apps.
